3. Greatest movie ever but the ending was too scary.

Oh great live action Moana

Part of why right wingers were convinced they were going to sink The Odyssey is that they had decided it was because of them that the visually repellent, barely-promoted live action Moana flopped, I guess in retaliation for not making her white or something
